summary: Explains that all new ansible-core development happens on devel, bugfixes merge there first before backporting, a stable-X.Y branch is cut around Beta 1, and testing external content against devel isn't recommended.
questions: Where should I submit a bugfix for an older ansible-core release?
When does ansible-core cut a new stable branch?
Should I run CI for my collection against the devel branch?

answer_card.title: The ansible-core devel branch
answer_card.answer_md: All new development happens on `devel`. Bugfixes for older releases must be merged to `devel` first, then backported to stable branches. Around **Beta 1**, a `stable-X.Y` branch is cut from `devel`, which then moves on to `X.Y+1`. External automated testing against `devel` is generally not recommended.
